study: Sprint12 evidence-linked judgment; implementation-author diagnostic, not release acceptance

hypotheses.H1: Explicit conditional concern differs from observed harm; both concern and legitimate negative must work.
hypotheses.H2: Claim-level fact pointers may help reasoning, but membership is not relevance or entailment.
hypotheses.H3: A small judgment contract may avoid burdens of simultaneously filling the existing full response schema.
hypotheses.H4: Removing prospectively irrelevant optional fields while preserving all substantive counterevidence may alter decisions.
hypotheses.H5: Full-context narrow judgments generalize to 12 untouched opaque diagnostic examples.

D1: Six new development cases, each once with bundle and linked. Same messages/evidence/system/runtime. Bundle schema wraps the identical judgment plus current public pillar response schema; linked requests only judgment. Fixed counterbalanced ordering. This isolates schema burden within this task, not original end-to-end analyzer efficacy or evidence linking alone.
baseline_limit: Single generation only; original analyzer/retrieval/repair/reference sanitization not invoked. Full report is untrusted ancillary material, never institutional approval. Schema validity and analyzer availability separately reported. Both arms already use fact IDs, so H2 is not independently isolated.
D2: Exactly six linked development cases with optional fields omitted from model context only; compare D1 linked full. Canonical report still binds all selected fields. Optional-only policy is gold-invariant, preserves all required substantive fields. This modest irrelevant-context ablation cannot establish benefits of broad context reduction. No new prompt wording or runtime changes.
D2_falsification: If any paired core judgment worsens or high-impact unsupported claim appears, do not claim context reduction uniformly helps. Correlated examples and one generation each cannot identify a dominant cause.
D3: NOT RUN: preflight found no second completion model. No downloads or unused-capacity fishing.
H1_selection: Freeze full-context linked before D1 outcomes. Exactly12 diagnostic cases once; run even after poor semantic development unless source/authority/privacy/transport safety fails. No post-holdout tuning.
diagnostic_categories: Supported concern, legitimate negative, underdetermined, adversarial/context conflict; opaque identities. Scorer-only material is never passed to dispatch.
release_acceptance: NOT RUN and not authorized by this diagnostic; previous Aster/Juniper untouched
engineering_pass: All selected values bind source->actual dispatch (full; explicit optional omissions for compact)->canonical report->validated JSON/escaped Markdown; exact provenance; tamper/eligibility/forgery negative checks pass; no original route/default changes.
development_viability: Per arm all6 core decisions acceptable under frozen rubric, support/counterevidence materially relevant, no high-impact unsupported claim or wrong authority/control state; both cases per pillar must pass. Independent human semantic review remains PENDING regardless.
diagnostic_viability: Report12 with separate per-pillar4 denominators and ambiguous alternatives. A PASS requires all12 acceptable core judgments, relevant links/conditional useful advice and zero high-impact unsupported or authority-state failures. No population accuracy claims.
measures: ID membership separately from author-assessed relevance and pending human entailment
transport: Reuse unchanged audited Sprint11 socket/accounting. Fresh roots spruce-sprint12-development, spruce-sprint12-diagnostic, spruce-sprint12-campaign under ignored knowledge_base/workspaces. Legacy accounting aliases D1->D0,D2->D1,D3->D3,H1->A; H1 track internally named acceptance, explicitly diagnostic only. Legacy attempt prefix scoped to new roots. Reservation+fsync before each send; no retries/repair/proxy/redirect/cloud. Any UNKNOWN/pending blocks entire campaign.
retention: Only new synthetic wire requests, final visible answers, usage/hashes and result panels in ignored roots. Hidden thinking discarded. No real/private/unknown-sensitive source allowed. Committed readout contains synthetic results and masked reviewer packet; no secrets/environment/device identifiers.
stop_rules: Any UNKNOWN/pending prior send; provider identity mismatch/unavailable; no restart/fallback
Source/authority/privacy protection breach or missing required binding: stop subsequent sends and preserve failures
Known bounded length withholding counts once; no retry
Semantically poor results do not cancel secure diagnostic H1
No edits to frozen cases/rubric/config/implementation after first send; future work requires a new suite
review: Implementation-author prospective rubric and retrospective semantic review only. Masked shuffled packet plus separate concealed reviewer key; actual independent human review PENDING.
confounders: model vs task vs runtime vs rigid screening alternatives remain
